name: Rebuild a whole page in Elementor (one importable page template) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole page in Elementor
MiroMiro rebuilds every section of the page as Elementor, then n8n joins them, in page order, into **one page template**.

Download the .json from **Save the page template**, then in WordPress: *Templates > Saved Templates > Import Templates*, and insert it into any page.

25 credits per section; repeat calls within 24h are free.

**Setup (1 minute)**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
2. Open any MiroMiro node > Credential > Create new, paste the key.
3. Change the website in **Settings**, then click **Execute workflow**.
